    Nilpotence of proper string graph components #

    Proper component maps define directed partial-bijection steps on the finite set of positions above each displayed vertex. The proper ideal has no directed position cycle: a cycle would produce an element of the ideal with diagonal coefficient one. Conversely, every nonzero coefficient of a power of an element of the ideal produces a position chain of the same length. Pigeonhole therefore gives a uniform nilpotence bound.
